# 💖 Supporting Secure Dialer

Hey everyone! Thank you so much for considering supporting **Secure Dialer**!

Secure Dialer is built as a **100% free, open-source (GPLv3), ad-free, and tracker-free** Android phone app. My goal is simple: your dialer should protect your privacy, feel super fast and responsive on any phone, and never send your private data across the internet.

---

## 💡 Why Sponsorship Helps

Because Secure Dialer is completely offline, there are no remote servers or cloud API bills to pay.

Your support directly helps fund the **time, testing hardware, and tools** needed to maintain a high-quality Android app:

1. **Testing Across Physical Devices:** Buying different test phones (Samsung, Google Pixel, Xiaomi, Motorola, older Android phones, and custom ROMs like GrapheneOS and LineageOS) so I can test call screening, dual-SIM support, and UI performance on real hardware.
2. **Dedicated Development Time:** Writing Jetpack Compose UI code, optimizing Room SQLCipher database performance, fixing bugs reported by users, and keeping dependencies updated.
3. **Android Tools & Licenses:** Developer tooling and testing infrastructure.

---
